svg.aria-label: Health Tracker: log from your Pixel Watch, see the detail in a dashboard, ask your AI assistant about your data, all on your own Cloudflare account.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Health Tracker

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: One tap on your watch.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Log coffee, water, mood and supplements
from the dial. Sleep, pulse and workouts
fill in on their own.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Your day, in detail.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: A five-tab dashboard shows your night,
your vitals, your activity and your
routine against what is usual for you.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Ask what your data knows.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Your AI assistant reads your history and answers:
what helps you sleep, what changed,
what tends to go with what.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Yours, end to end.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Runs on your own Cloudflare account: your
database, your server, your AI client.
Open source under MIT.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: What could I do to sleep better?

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: In your data, nights after a coffee past 16:00 have
about 20 minutes less deep sleep. Try two weeks
without late coffee and I will check if it holds.
